standard-dialogue.speaker: Pipistrelle Draynar
standard-dialogue.text: I don't know, darling. Why don't you ask them?

steps.npc: Hello, [vampyre name]. I'm Caninelle Draynar and this is Pipistrelle Draynar.
Hello, [player name]. I'm Caninelle Draynar and this is Pipistrelle Draynar.

standard-dialogue.speaker: Pipistrelle Draynar
standard-dialogue.text: Oh yes. The Draynar family has been around since before vampyres came to this world.

standard-dialogue.npc: Over time, some people took the name and started pronouncing it differently. Hence Draynor.

standard-dialogue.speaker: Pipistrelle Draynar
standard-dialogue.text: Draynor is more commonly used as a first name though, with Draynar as a last name.

standard-dialogue.player: Thanks for the information. I wonder if there's a Draynor Draynar out there.

standard-dialogue-if-the-player-is-not-d.speaker: Caninelle/Pipistrelle Draynar
standard-dialogue-if-the-player-is-not-d.text: Human! Get back to the slave pens before I call the guards!
